releaseSummary: Portal customers can preview saved drafts, open lab-order details, collapse account navigation, and use a roomier support assistant with in-place chat history and dictation.
Barbados lab prices are identified as BBD, web-cart prices remain identified as USD, and users without price access no longer see pricing-availability language in Rx ordering.

moduleImpact.notes: Updated as part of Customer portal experience pass.

migrationNotes: No manual data migration is required for this release.
